t: Paul Arizin - Hall of Fame Basketball Player
s: August 10, 2020 - Paul Arizin starred at Villanova University, where he was a 1949-50 NCAA AP All-America First Team selection. He played his entire NBA career with the Philadelphia Warriors and led them to an NBA championship in 1956. Paul was one of the pioneers of the one-handed jump shot in an age where most of the league still favored the two-handed set shot.
